split_policy: Retain official splits. Uniform random sampling within each split, with no balancing. Remove empty texts and punctuation/case/whitespace-normalized duplicate texts within and across sampled splits, in train/validation/test order. Thread/video identifiers are not present in this mirror; group leakage and fuzzy near-duplicates are unresolved limitations.
features: Comment text only. Fit vocabulary and IDF on training only. No annotation fields as input.
selection: Select between word and word_char on validation recall at 10% review capacity; break a tie by validation average precision.
threshold: Separately freeze the selected model's validation score at rank ceil(0.10 * validation size). Report test outcomes without retuning it.
tie_breaker: Ascending SHA-256 of split and original source-row index; independent of labels.
target: At least 10% relative increase in toxic comments captured versus rules at 10% capacity, paired bootstrap recall difference lower bound above zero. Threat and contextual false-positive checks remain necessary before a pilot.
uncertainty: 500 paired row bootstrap resamples, reranking each strategy within each resample, 95% percentile interval. Does not account for unobserved thread clusters.
